_comment: GDD 11. Quest rules are deterministic: steps complete from game events and flags, rewards are fixed and saved. The AI Game Master may only RECOMMEND quests (by their topics); it can never change steps or rewards. Step types: talk(npc), win_battles(count), capture(count), visit(area), challenge(id), flags_all([...]), flag(name), open_chests(count).

fading_numera.title: THE FADING NUMERA
fading_numera.summary: The Numera is fading from Number Forest. Restore the three Numera Seals in the Ancient Number Ruins, then face the Arithmetic Beast at the old stone arch.

steps.text: Meet Professor Numeris in Starter Village.
Win a battle in the Green Meadow grass.
Reach the Ancient Number Ruins (south-east).
Restore the three Numera Seals in the ruins.
Defeat THE ARITHMETIC BEAST at the stone arch.

lost_numbers.title: THE LOST NUMBERS
lost_numbers.summary: Mira dropped three numbered stones while fleeing a wild VOLTIX. Each stone only answers to the right arithmetic.

steps.text: Talk to Mira in Starter Village.
Stone I: in the Green Meadow grass, east of the crossroads.
Stone II: among the crops of Sunny Farms.
Stone III: in Woolly Pasture, near the arena.
Bring the stones back to Mira.

broken_bridge.title: THE BROKEN BRIDGE
broken_bridge.summary: Bram the builder needs the plank and rail sums for the plateau bridge to the Sunsand Desert.

steps.text: Talk to Bram at the plateau bridge (east of the falls).
Work out the materials for the bridge.

crystal_seal.title: THE CRYSTAL SEAL
crystal_seal.summary: An ancient crystal on Waterfall Plateau hums with broken fractions. Solve them to wake it.

steps.text: Solve the fraction puzzles at the Crystal Seal.

unknown_runes.title: THE UNKNOWN RUNES
unknown_runes.summary: A stone tablet in Pine Ridge is covered in equations. Each solved rune reveals the value hidden behind an x.

steps.text: Solve the runes on the stone tablet in Pine Ridge.

hidden_treasures.title: HIDDEN TREASURES
hidden_treasures.summary: Old chests are hidden all over Number Forest. Explore every corner.

steps.text: Open 4 treasure chests anywhere in Number Forest.

unknown_guardian.title: THE UNKNOWN GUARDIAN
unknown_guardian.summary: Dr. Vexa's old laboratory is sealed by three Variable Seals. Behind them, a guardian hides every unknown.

steps.text: Meet Dr. Vexa at the Cave Mouth.
Win 2 battles in the glowing tunnels.
Restore the three Variable Seals.
Defeat THE UNKNOWN GUARDIAN in the Lost Laboratory.

lab_notes.title: THE LAB NOTES
lab_notes.summary: Finish an old scientist's notes on negative numbers and equations.

steps.text: Complete the notes at the lab terminal.

dimension_dragon.title: THE DIMENSION COLOSSUS
dimension_dragon.summary: Sir Hypot guards the Geometry Kingdom. The Dimension Colossus has folded its castle into impossible shapes.

steps.text: Meet Sir Hypot at the Temple Gate.
Cross the kingdom to the Pillar Court.
Restore the three Geometry Seals.
Defeat CRYSTALGON, the Dimension Colossus, in the Dragon Keep.

royal_garden.title: THE ROYAL GARDEN
royal_garden.summary: The royal gardener left plans for new flower beds - but no sums.

steps.text: Work out the garden plans.

infinite_overlord.title: THE INFINITE OVERLORD
infinite_overlord.summary: Time has stopped in the Chronos Dimension. Keeper Tick needs the three Time Seals restored before the Infinite Overlord can be faced.

steps.text: Meet Keeper Tick at the Clock Gate.
Win 3 battles on the floating isles.
Restore the three Time Seals.
Defeat THE INFINITE OVERLORD at the Time Spire.

broken_clocks.title: THE BROKEN CLOCKS
broken_clocks.summary: Three stopped clocks on the isles each hide a puzzle in time.

steps.text: Repair the broken clocks.

echoes_of_the_tallyfolk.title: ECHOES OF THE TALLYFOLK
echoes_of_the_tallyfolk.summary: Old Abacus wants every Tallyfolk inscription in Number Forest read and remembered.

steps.text: Talk to Old Abacus in Starter Village.
Read the Counting Stone, the meadow tally stones and the Arch of Sums inscription.
Tell Old Abacus what the stones say.

missing_mathmon.title: THE MISSING MATHMON
missing_mathmon.summary: Tobi's DIVOWL, Sums, flew off to Pine Ridge when the Counting Stone flickered. Catch a DIVOWL to bring him home.

steps.text: Catch a DIVOWL (try Pine Ridge or the meadow).
Bring Sums home to Tobi.

the_professors_journal.title: THE PROFESSOR'S JOURNAL
the_professors_journal.summary: Keeper Tick gave you a rusty key the Professor left in Chronos twenty years ago. It fits a drawer in his lab.

steps.text: Open the locked drawer in the Professor's lab.

the_last_calculation.title: THE LAST CALCULATION
the_last_calculation.summary: Vera has begun the Last Calculation at the Origin Engine. Every lesson of your journey leads here.

steps.text: Speak to Vera at the Zero Point beneath the Time Spire.
Check the Last Calculation with Vera and the Professor.
Decide what happens to the Engine.

stone_1.title: NUMBERED STONE I
stone_1.intro: The stone is warm. A sum is carved into it.

stone_2.title: NUMBERED STONE II
stone_2.intro: Rows of seeds are carved into this stone.

stone_3.title: NUMBERED STONE III
stone_3.intro: This stone is split into equal grooves.

bridge_plan.title: BRIDGE PLANS
bridge_plan.intro: Bram unrolls a plan. 'Help me get the numbers right and the bridge goes back up today!'

crystal_seal.title: THE CRYSTAL SEAL
crystal_seal.intro: Three facets flicker. Each one shows a broken fraction.

rune_tablet.title: THE UNKNOWN RUNES
rune_tablet.intro: Each rune hides a number behind an x.

seal_add.title: SEAL OF SUMS
seal_add.intro: The seal's light flickers between plus and minus.

seal_mul.title: SEAL OF PRODUCTS
seal_mul.intro: Grids of light fold into equal groups.

seal_frac.title: SEAL OF PARTS
seal_frac.intro: A crystal disc waits to be cut into fair parts.

seal_x1.title: SEAL OF UNKNOWNS
seal_x1.intro: Runes of x glow on the stone. Find what each x is worth.

seal_x2.title: SEAL OF BALANCE
seal_x2.intro: A great stone scale. Both sides must weigh the same.

seal_x3.title: SEAL OF PAIRS
seal_x3.intro: Two equations are carved side by side. They share their secrets.

lab_notes.title: THE LAB NOTES
lab_notes.intro: A dusty terminal still holds an old scientist's half-finished notes.

seal_g1.title: SEAL OF AREAS
seal_g1.intro: The floor of this seal is a grid of tiles waiting to be counted.

seal_g2.title: SEAL OF ANGLES
seal_g2.intro: Beams of light cross at every angle but one.

seal_g3.title: SEAL OF SOLIDS
seal_g3.intro: A cube and a right angle are carved in the stone.

royal_garden.title: THE ROYAL GARDEN
royal_garden.intro: The royal gardener's plans need their sums.

seal_t1.title: SEAL OF PATTERNS
seal_t1.intro: Numbers spiral around the seal. One is always missing.

seal_t2.title: SEAL OF HOURS
seal_t2.intro: Clock hands are frozen. Set them right.

seal_t3.title: SEAL OF INFINITY
seal_t3.intro: The last seal mixes every idea you have learned.

broken_clocks.title: THE BROKEN CLOCKS
broken_clocks.intro: Three stopped clocks. Each shows a puzzle in time.

last_calculation.title: THE LAST CALCULATION
last_calculation.intro: The Origin Engine's nine dials turn towards you. Every chapter of your journey is in here. Check every step.
